name: InternScience/Sage-A1.5 model card
notes: Fetched 2026-10-22. HF repo InternScience/Sage-A1.5, created 2026-10-15 (API createdAt), licence apache-2.0 (tag), pipeline_tag text-generation with image-text-to-text in tags, not gated. safetensors total 35,951,822,704 BF16. Card describes a ~35B MoE agentic model built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and InternScience/Agents-A1; technical report arXiv 2610.28578. The card publishes an HTML benchmark table with 22 benchmark rows and 6 columns: Sage-A1.5, Agents-A1, Ornith-1.5 (the ~35B comparables) then Kimi-K3, GLM-5.3, GPT-5.6-sol (larger scale). Every row used in models/sage-a1-5 was read from the Sage-A1.5 column of that table. Footnotes: SWE series uses the mini-SWE-agent harness at temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, 200K-token context, automatic compaction, offline; GLM-5.3 has no OmniDocBench row because it is text-only. BrowseComp and DeepResearch-Bench2 are printed TWICE per column, 'w/o Agentic Orchestration' and 'w/ Agentic Orchestration'; the orchestrated number requires an opt-in subagent harness described later in the card, so both numbers are stated in the records rather than just the headline. All values are vendor claims.
